name: DCA in — bid side
description: Single-sided quote below the active bin, Bid-Ask weighted toward the far bid.
placeholderNote: Placeholder. Single-sided quote below price is the public DCA-in example. It is not a signal that you should buy a token.
notes: Docs: to DCA into a token, deposit the quote single-sided and place liquidity on bins below the current price, using Bid-Ask or selected bins. As price moves down, quote converts into the base token. Bins below the active bin hold one side of the pair. This rule only auto-matches smaller, already-volatile pools.
